name: Falcon Perception (TII)
usage: Segmentation from a text query: instance masks for named objects or surfaces

licence.note: no LICENSE file in the Hugging Face repository

release_date.note: repository creation date; RL revision branch dated 19.08.2026

size_gb.note: safetensors; 6 remote-code .py files not needed with mlx-vlm

runtimes.value: mlx-vlm `falcon_perception` (v0.7.12, loads the official repository); pip `falcon-perception` 1.0.0 (PyTorch and MLX paths)

web.scope: Released 22.02.2026: last 6 months plus launch. Hacker News (no comment found), Hugging Face discussions, GitHub issues of tiiuae/Falcon-Perception. Reddit not readable. **Feedback thin.**
web.summary: Early MLX memory leak fixed; server memory sizing issue; detection of small, occluded or reflective objects reported as unreliable.
web.verdict: Promising open text-to-mask model; thin feedback

comments.text: MLX batch inference leaked about 50 GB on Apple Silicon with 50–100 objects, fixed by PR #3 on 07.04.2026 ([#2, 02.04.2026](https://github.com/tiiuae/Falcon-Perception/issues/2)); the server tried to allocate 56 GB on 24 GB GPUs, KV-cache size had to be hard-coded ([#5, 05.04.2026](https://github.com/tiiuae/Falcon-Perception/issues/5)).
Prompt-based detection works "only in some cases" for small, occluded or reflective objects ([#25, 11.06.2026](https://github.com/tiiuae/Falcon-Perception/issues/25)).
The Hugging Face main branch is not synced with a GitHub patch ([HF discussion #4, 12.05.2026](https://huggingface.co/tiiuae/Falcon-Perception/discussions/4)).
